name: cs-navigator
description: Route capability-selection questions using verifiable trust, freshness, permissions, execution evidence, and Skill Container boundaries.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator 0.7.5 routes capability-selection questions using current verifiable-trust evidence, freshness, permissions, security findings, Risk Labels, known gaps, and Skill Container decision boundaries while keeping ordinary direct tasks with ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Tell me whether this task needs a skill or ChatGPT can handle it directly.
Find the smallest useful CS capability for this goal and show the material trust or permission trade-off.
Explain a Container Guardian decision without claiming runtime enforcement unless a real decision record is present.
